notes.title: Updates and fixes.
notes.notes:
Hello,

We have a huge amount of feature updates and fixes. We watched and read  [u] all [/u]  of the critiques from the pre-alpha demo and implemented them as best as we could. There is still work to do but the project is getting more and more exciting for us.

Here's a full list below :

- Mouse Sensitivity fixed.
- Gamma and brightness updated, additional lighting 
- Player height / ratio updated
- Level Design and detail ( Signs, posters ) fixed for easier exploration and game play.
- A City Map can be found for navigation. 
- More Investigative and detective game play aspects.
- Evidence Log included in game.
- Voice over added.
- Hallucinations added
- Warning signals for being Spotted.
- Complete new areas of the city added.
- Code Puzzles added.
- Menu Completed.
- Added game play elements.
- Added music, soundtrack.
- Updated UI.
- Grammar and text issues fixed. 

Be back soon with more info.
Thanks for checking us out.
- Erik
